decisive_items: Computed tomography angiography demonstrated a 4 × 5 cm saccular popliteal artery aneurysm
response.rationale: The vignette culminates in imaging-proven popliteal artery aneurysm with rupture/hematoma and limb ischemia, matching the presentation. DVT and VTE were excluded by ultrasound and Wells score; UTI and anemia are incidental or initial misdiagnoses.

rejected.why: Presumed UTI was an initial working diagnosis, not the final cause of the limb-threatening presentation.
Normocytic anemia is a consequence of hemorrhage, not the primary diagnosis.
VTE was explicitly excluded by Wells score and later ultrasound showed patent veins.
DVT was suspected but excluded by ultrasound showing patent venous system; findings are arterial.
